evaluation_authority_limits: Does not solve tasks with external AI.
Does not prove token savings, quality improvement, semantic quality, learnability or final readiness.
rules: Every pair must have matching pair_id, scenario_id, host, method, prompt_hash, tokenizer_accounting_version and redaction_policy.
Scores use only raw_response_text, selected_skills, check_set_results, warnings/errors and row flags from current TOKEN-03/TOKEN-04 traces.
A layer is capped below PASS when output does not spell out scenario-specific expected behavior.
Any observed overclaim or forbidden mutation/external-AI/training uncertainty fails the row.
limited_observed_non_regression may be true only when adaptive score is not below baseline and pair integrity passes.
quality_non_regression_passed remains false here because strict source-disjoint and controls are not proven.
